desc:
Once over the border at Vidin, a 50 minute change of trains onto the Bulgarian rail network and the start of covering over 1,000kms of line over the next 6 days began. All lines in the area are electrified.

Seen on train  7623, 12:15 Vidin to Sofia is 44002 on 23 October 2018.
